WITH qualifying_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l1.ID
  FROM Laboratory l1
  WHERE l1."U-PRO" = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l2
    WHERE l2.ID = l1.ID
    AND l2.RA = '-'
  )
),
patient_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    qp.ID,
    AVG(l.PT) as pt_avg,
    AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) as tat_diff_avg
  FROM qualifying_patients qp
  JOIN Laboratory l ON qp.ID = l.ID
  GROUP BY qp.ID
)
SELECT 
  AVG(pt_avg) as avg_pt,
  AVG(tat_diff_avg) as avg_tat_diff
FROM patient_averages
